protocol: First select Korean news claims and write one English search phrase per claim, using only those two news articles. Then consult one contemporary official English announcement per article. Evaluate the resulting evidence from that announcement only. Freeze reference paragraph IDs and normalized file digests before opening the retrieval code or running searches. Take the complete selected Korean sentence as the default query. Full direct reference paragraph within top 1 and 3 counts; context preview alone does not. Count unresolved cases separately, never as true or false on a lexical hit. Evaluate the same prewritten English queries in the working old search and new method.
